purpose: Independent exploratory attribution of two prespecified channel rules over six previously seen windows; no new replay, ranking or selection.

definitions.R: abs(actual entry price-initial stop)*quantity; arithmetic means equally weight completed trades
definitions.grossBeforeCosts: grossPnl+recorded slippageAndRounding; original realized-path attribution, not a zero-cost counterfactual
definitions.timeExposure: Arithmetic mean of six native exposurePct observations: share of observed minutes with a position per equal-capital sleeve. Not notional exposure or beta.
definitions.topFive: Five largest positive netPnl completed trades across the six sleeves in that window. Share denominator is all positive netPnl, unless the field explicitly says total net PnL. Removing them is ledger attribution only, not a replay and not an acceptance test.
definitions.comparison: 2025 PA reference shares symbols, dates, initial capital and fee/slippage assumptions, but changes entry, direction, timeframe, exit and opportunity path; it is a whole-strategy comparison, not a timeframe causal effect.
